description: Dropping a Svelte 5 data grid row onto any element outside the grid. The rowDropZone action marks an Archive and a Delete bucket as targets for managed row drags: the dragged task leaves the grid and the zone's onDrop handles it. The grid keeps rowDragManaged so in-grid reorder still works, and a rowDragGroup that the zones match on.
keywords: svelte table drag row to delete
svelte drag row out of grid
svelte archive bucket drag and drop

faq.question: How do I make an element accept rows from the grid?
faq.answer: Apply use:rowDropZone={{ group, onDrop }} to it with the same group string as the grid's rowDragGroup. When a row is released over the element, the grid removes it and onDrop receives an event with the row.

faq.question: Can the same grid still reorder its own rows?
faq.answer: Yes. rowDragManaged stays on, so dropping inside the grid reorders and dropping on a zone removes; the target decides which happens.

faq.question: How do I show the zone as active during a drag?
faq.answer: The action adds sv-grid-row-dropzone-over to the element while a matching drag hovers it, or a class of your own through overClass, which the demo styles as a highlighted bucket.
